title: oily golden American Butter Scrambled
description: Buttery, fluffy, crowd-pleaser American dish featuring dried red chillies, caramelize, satvik-friendly, vessel=tava-griddle.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a pinch of salt and a few grinds of black pepper.
Melt 20g of butter in a tava-griddle over medium heat.
Once the butter is melted, add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the dried red chillies and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour the whisked eggs over the onion mixture and cook until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently scramble the eggs, breaking them up into small curds.
Continue cooking and stirring the eggs until they are cooked through and fluffy.
Stir in the remaining 40g of butter until it is fully incorporated and the scrambled eggs are oily and golden.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
